info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Bank Portfolio Analysi Analyse-spec
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Analysis API enables financial institutions to perform detailed analyses of their banking portfolios. This endpoint allows users to submit request data for comprehensive evaluation, which can include risk assessments and performance metrics. Typical consumers include treasury departments and financial analysts looking to optimize bank portfolio management. By leveraging this API, institutions can make informed decisions based on analytical insights tailored for their specific banking portfolios.

post.summary: Create a new bank portfolio analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new bank portfolio analysis by submitting the required data. Ensure that all necessary parameters are included in the request for a successful analysis creation.
